# Firestore Collections - Tennis Tracker Dashboard

This document details the Firestore collections and document structures required to power the dashboard features: Match Statistics, Kit Bag (Equipment), and Tournament Hub.

---

## 1. Matches (`matches`)
*Source:* Matches played and synchronized from the Wear OS app.
*Consumed by:* Match Analytics, Scouting.

**Document ID:** Auto-generated by Firebase (`matchId`)

```json
{
  "userId": "user_123",            // Owner of the match
  "idt": 1693488000000,            // Start timestamp (ms)
  "fdt": 1693494000000,            // End timestamp (ms)
  "rival": "Marian",
  "win": true,
  "firstService": true,            // True if owner served first
  "games": 23,                     // Total games
  "tiebreak": true,                // Any tiebreak occurred
  "supertb": false,
  
  // Owner Root Stats
  "me_points_won": 65,
  "me_breaks": 3,
  "me_break_points": 5,
  "me_serve_won": 40,
  
  // Rival Root Stats
  "him_points_won": 58,
  "him_breaks": 2,
  "him_break_points": 6,
  "him_serve_won": 38,
  
  // Sets Details
  "sets": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "idt": 1693488000000,
      "fdt": 1693490000000,
      "me": 6,
      "rival": 4,
      "is_complete": true,
      "stats": {
        "me": { "breaks": 1, "break_points": 2, "points_won_serving": 20 },
        "him": { "breaks": 0, "break_points": 1, "points_won_serving": 15 }
      }
    }
  ],
  
  // Correlated Health Data (from watch sensors)
  "health_metrics": {
    "active_calories": 540,
    "total_steps": 3200,
    "duration_ms": 6000000,
    "heart_rate": {
      "avg": 135,
      "max": 172
    }
  }
}
```

*Required Indexes:* `userId` (ASC), `idt` (DESC) - for fetching history timeline.

---

## 2. Equipment Collections

Used heavily by the **Kit Bag** feature to track gear lifecycle.

### 2.a Racquets (`equipment/{userId}/racquets`)

```json
{
  "name": "Babolat Pure Aero",
  "brand": "Babolat",
  "role": "primary",               // "primary" | "backup" | "retired"
  "stringSetup": {
    "name": "RPM Blast 17g",
    "tension": 54,
    "unit": "lbs"                  // "lbs" | "kg"
  },
  "lastRestringDate": 1692000000000,
  "hoursPlayed": 12.5,             // Aggregated total from matched logged since last restring
  "estimatedLifeHours": 20,        // When to warn user
  "imageUrl": "gs://bucket/path/aero.jpg" // Optional Firebase Storage ref
}
```

### 2.b Shoes (`equipment/{userId}/shoes`)

```json
{
  "model": "Court FF 3",
  "brand": "Asics",
  "status": "active",              // "active" | "retired"
  "distanceCoveredKm": 42.8,       // Aggregated from matches health_metrics
  "surface": "Hard Court",         // Primary surface used on
  "imageUrl": "gs://bucket/path/courtff3.jpg"
}
```

### 2.c Maintenance Logs (`equipment/{userId}/maintenance_logs`)
Feed for the recent activity timeline.

```json
{
  "type": "restring",              // "restring" | "overgrip" | "new_gear" | "repair"
  "gearRef": "racquets/doc_id",    // Reference to the item
  "date": 1692000000000,
  "notes": "Changed to RPM Blast at 54lbs. Feels crisp."
}
```

*Required Indexes:* `date` (DESC) - to fetch recent logs.

---

## 3. Tournament Hub Collections

Manages structured competitive play brackets.

### 3.a Tournaments (`tournaments`)

```json
{
  "name": "Local Club Championship",
  "category": "ATP 100",           // Custom classification
  "surface": "Red Clay",
  "location": {
    "city": "Paris",
    "country": "France",
    "venue": "Stade Roland Garros"
  },
  "dateRange": {
    "start": 1684000000000,
    "end": 1686000000000
  },
  "imageUrl": "gs://bucket/path/venue.jpg"
}
```

### 3.b Bracket Matches (`tournaments/{tournamentId}/matches`)
Models the tournament tree for the `userId`.

```json
{
  "userId": "user_123",            // The user participating
  "round": "Semi-Finals",
  "opponent": "N. Djokovic",
  "opponentSeed": 2,               // Nullable
  "score": "6-4, 6-4",             // Stored when matched finishes
  "result": "win",                 // "win" | "loss" | null
  "status": "completed",           // "completed" | "upcoming" | "live" | "tbd"
  "court": "Philippe-Chatrier",
  "scheduledTime": 1685500000000
}
```

*Required Indexes:* `userId` (ASC), `status` (ASC), `scheduledTime` (ASC) - for "upcoming matches" view.
